headline: Emory & Henry overtake Catawba at the top
dek: Emory & Henry's home win over Newberry on Saturday lifted them a point above Catawba, who have a match in hand. The two are the only sides in the conference yet to lose, and they drew with each other at Catawba in September.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored nineteen and conceded four: they top the table by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Emory & Henry have conceded four goals all season and now sit above unbeaten Catawba.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's home win over Newberry on Saturday was their sixth of the season, against two draws and no defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tusculum's home win over Lenoir-Rhyne on Sunday was their second of the season, against two draws and eight defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's home win over Wingate on Sunday was their seventh of the season, against two draws and four defeats, with twenty-four scored and thirteen conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's home win over Mars Hill on Sunday was their eighth of the season, against four draws and two defeats.

last_match.line: Tusculum have their first conference win; Lenoir-Rhyne followed their home win over Anderson with a defeat.

next_match.line: Newberry have not won since beating Lincoln Memorial in September; Montevallo have lost at both Anderson and Lincoln Memorial.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
